description: This file implements a KeystoreService in Go, providing functionality for secure storage, retrieval, deletion, and listing of cryptographic keys, with support for encryption/decryption using AES-GCM. It includes methods for key management and file-based persistence.

classes.name: KeystoreService
classes.description: A service managing secure storage of cryptographic keys, supporting encryption, decryption, key file management, and optional backup functionality.

methods.name: NewKeystoreService
methods.description: Initializes a new KeystoreService with AES-GCM encryption, setting up necessary directories and cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: StoreKey
methods.description: Encrypts and stores a key identified by keyID into the keystore directory.

methods.name: RetrieveKey
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts a key stored in the keystore identified by keyID.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Removes a key file from the keystore directory.

methods.name: ListKeys
methods.description: Lists all key identifiers present in the keystore directory.

methods.name: BackupKeys
methods.description: Creates a backup of all keys if backup is enabled. (Stub implementation)

methods.name: EncryptData
methods.description: Encrypts arbitrary data using AES-GCM with the keystore's cryptographic key.
